ledger.x: c. 3 BC: the Hermunduri are settled in Marcomannic territory. Cassius Dio says Lucius Domitius Ahenobarbus 'had taken under his protection the Hermunduri' and 'then settled them in Marcomannic territory'. The date is Cassius Dio's 'c. 3 BC' on the page; the land is the researcher's reading. [Reviewer eu-04-x…

c. 19 AD: Vibilius overthrows the Marcomannic king Catualda. 'Tacitus says Vibilius led the overthrow of the Marcomannic king Catualda'; the Marcomanni page: Vibilius 'deposed Catualda' and the displaced Marcomanni were placed under Vannius. The page does not say the Hermunduri took the land; the gain is a bridge.

c. 50: Vibilius deposes Vannius and Bohemia returns to the Marcomanni (bridge). 'Vibilius deposed Vannius with help from Vannius' nephews and the Lugii, probably in what is now Moravia and Slovakia' (c. 50 AD); the page is silent on Bohemia. The marcomanni dossier has the matching gain in 51.

wars.name: Hermunduri-Chatti war over the salt river
wars.outcome: The Hermunduri defeated the Chatti in a border dispute over a salt-bearing river (Tacitus; 57 AD on the Hermunduri page, 58 on the Chatti page).

wars.name: Marcomannic Wars
wars.outcome: The Historia Augusta places the Hermunduri in an alliance with the Marcomanni, Sarmatians and Quadi against Rome (180); Marcus Aurelius died in 180.

certainty.note: The page gives rivers and the Danube only; no frontier.
